subtasks.title: Core state machine engine porting with ESP32-S3 adaptations
subtasks.description: Port the existing state machine engine to ESP32-S3, adapting memory allocation, task management, and timing to ESP-IDF/FreeRTOS
subtasks.details:
Implement StateMachine class with ESP32-specific memory allocation using heap_caps_malloc for PSRAM support. Adapt state transition logic to use FreeRTOS task notifications. Replace std::chrono with esp_timer for timing. Implement thread-safe state transitions using FreeRTOS mutexes. Add ESP_LOG macros for debugging.
<info added on 2025-07-10T19:11:00.943Z>
COMPLETED: ESP32-S3 state machine core engine fully implemented with comprehensive ESP32 adaptations. Added ESP_LOG debugging throughout StateMachine.cpp and State.h base class. Implemented PSRAM memory allocation with heap_caps_malloc and automatic fallback to regular heap. Added memory monitoring tracking both heap and PSRAM usage including minimum memory watermarks. Integrated FreeRTOS task watchdog for crash recovery with enable/disable controls. Replaced timing with esp_timer for high-precision measurements during transitions and performance monitoring. Implemented thread-safe transitions using semaphores with timeout handling and emergency recovery mechanisms. Added stack usage monitoring via uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark. Created ESP32-specific utility methods getUsedHeap() and getUsedPSRAM() for runtime diagnostics. All compilation successful - core state machine engine ready for interface implementations.
</info added on 2025-07-10T19:11:00.943Z>
